data.name: Raisha
data.gender_notes: Raisha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is a little princess or a princess in her own right. The name Raisha carries the meaning “Little Princess” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Raisha usually hope their child will grow to embody little princess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is destined to be a leader or a ruler in her own right, and to bring joy and beauty to those around her
data.etymology: Raisha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Princess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raisha total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: رايشة
in_arabic.meaning: رايشة تعني الفتاة الحسناء ذات الوجه البشوش
in_arabic.long_meaning: رايشة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'رأش' الذي يعني الإشراق والضياء، ويرمز إلى الفتاة التي تتميز بجمالها وبهجة وجهها، وقد ورد في بعض المراجع أنها تعني الفتاة التي تسرح شعرها وتزيينه، وقد ذكر بعض العلماء أنها من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة والشرف في المجتمع العربي الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: رای샤
in_urdu.meaning: رای샤 کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت لڑکی جس کے چہرے پر مسکراہٹ ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: رای샤 ایک عربی मूल کا اسم مؤنث ہے، جو 'رأش' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے چمک اور روشنی، یہ نام خوبصورت چہرے اور خوش خلقی کی علامت ہے، جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا استعمال شائع ہے، جہاں یہ خوبصورتی اور شرافت کی صفات سے وابستہ ہے، اور اکثر اس کے معنی خوبصورت اور خوش گفتار لڑکی کے طور پر بیان किए جاتے ہیں.

in_hindi.name: रायशा
in_hindi.meaning: रायशा का अर्थ है सुंदर मुस्कराहट वाली लड़की
in_hindi.long_meaning: रायशा एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो 'रअश' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है चमक और प्रकाश, यह नाम सुंदर चेहरे और अच्छे स्वभाव की प्रतीक है, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका उपयोग आम है, जहां यह सुंदरता और शालीनता के गुणों से जुड़ा हुआ है, और अक्सर इसके अर्थ सुंदर और सुशील लड़की के रूप में वर्णित किए जाते हैं.

in_pashto.name: رايشه
in_pashto.meaning: رايشه د ښکلې نجلۍ په معنی ده چی مخ یې موسکی وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: رايشه د عربي اصل يو نوم دی، چی د 'رأش' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چی د چمک او روښنايي معنی ورکوي، دا نوم د ښکلې مخ او خوش اخلاقۍ نښه ده، په افغان او پښتون ثقافت کی دا نوم د استعمال په عام دی، چیرته چې دا د ښکلايي او عزت صفاتو سره تړلی دی، او ډیری وختونه د ښکلې او خوش گفتار نجلۍ په معنی کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Raisha
in_english.meaning: Raisha means beautiful girl with a cheerful face
in_english.long_meaning: Raisha is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'rأش' which means to shine or radiate light, it symbolizes a girl characterized by her beauty and cheerful countenance, in Islamic tradition, this name is associated with positive attributes such as beauty, joy, and nobility, historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a girl with a pleasant demeanor and attractive appearance.

pronunciation.urdu: رایشہ کا تلفظ ہے رائے شہ

data.cultural_impact: The name Raisha carries an aura of royalty, elegance, and power. In the Islamic culture, the name Raisha can be associated with strong and resilient women who lead to be the heroes and change-makers within their families and societies. In modern times, Raisha may represent a young girl brought up with great respect, dignity, and confidence, reflecting the values of a noble and proud heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: Raisha holds deep spiritual significance as it denotes the essence of being a God-sent princess. It symbolizes the notion of a woman who follows the path of “Tawheed” – the belief in the Oneness of God – while upholding herself with pride, dignity, and respect. It serves as a reminder that every woman is a masterpiece created by the Almighty, holding power and divine rights granted by Allah (SWT). The name Raisha inspires us to strive spiritually, purposefully, and gracefully, with unwavering faith and belief.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Little Princess" symbolizes She who is a little princess or a princess in her own right. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Raisha serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of little princess.
